description: Accessibility-first browser & computer use for AI agents — one MCP server for every harness (Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Antigravity). Instruments the DOM/accessibility tree via CDP instead of screenshot loops: diffed snapshots, stable element refs, trusted input, typed errors. Zero dependencies
